ruling.recommended_action: Prepare case file for Trust & Safety human review: preserve trip chat log and driver statement; assess threat-of-assault allegation; consider interim suspension of the rider's booking access pending review (SAFE-4); if the human reviewer finds no violation, lift any interim measure.
ruling.reasoning: The dispute as filed is a safety matter and the record contains a concrete threat. The chat shows the driver asking the rider not to smoke [F3] and the rider replying "Say that again and I will punch you." [F4], corroborated by the driver's statement [F6] (the statement merely repeats the chat content, so there is no conflict to resolve). This is an intimidation/violence threat directed at the driver's safety, so SAFE-1 and SAFE-2 require escalation rather than a ruling; SAFE-3 bars the system from assigning fault or recommending a substantive outcome on safety incidents. The trip record itself is unremarkable — actual distance equals optimal (+0.0 km, [F1]) and duration was under estimate [F2] — so no fare or route issue is present; the only issue is safety. Profiles [F7][F8] show no prior disputes or upheld violations on either side and cannot decide a case in any event. Evidence is otherwise complete and timestamped [F5]; the reason for escalation is the safety content, not a missing record. Route-deviation segment findings are not applicable.
ruling.escalation_reason: Safety incident: rider made a threat of physical violence ("I will punch you") toward the driver during the trip (SAFE-1, SAFE-2). System may only assemble the case file; fault determination and outcome rest with a human reviewer (SAFE-3).
